name: Ego4D
tagline: 3,670 h of daily-life video from 931 camera wearers at 74 sites in 9 countries; every hour narrated (3.85M sentences).

annotations.coverageNote: Narrations cover all 3,670 h (13.2 sentences/min). Audio 2,535 h, IMU 836 h, 3D scans 491 h, stereo 80 h, gaze 45 h; benchmark labels on subsets.

narrations.note: 3.85M dense timestamped sentences ('#C C picks up ...') plus clip summaries

action_labels.note: Moments Queries: 110 activity classes with segments (~300 h); FHO verb-noun labels

object_boxes.note: FHO hand and object boxes on critical frames (~116 h); VQ response tracks (~403 h)

hand_pose.note: Hands appear only as 2D boxes in FHO

gaze.note: Raw eye gaze for 45 h (Indiana U. and Georgia Tech captures)

camera_pose.note: VQ3D subset only: poses estimated by registering frames to Matterport scans

scene_3d.note: Matterport3D meshes for 491 h of video (subset of sites)

audio_transcript.note: AV diarization + speech transcription on a ~50 h subset

qa_language.note: NLQ natural-language queries (~240 h); Goal-Step hierarchical step labels

samples.caption: Collage of first-person frames: shopping, cooking, mowing, bike repair, card games
